heroes.name: The Curious Knight
heroes.lore: A wanderer who came for the legend and stayed for the fight. A sword, a coat of mail and no sense of when to leave.

heroes.name: The Barbarian
heroes.lore: From the frozen marches, where the moon is one more thing to kill. Hits harder, bleeds more, drinks last.

heroes.name: The Wizard
heroes.lore: He has read what the castle is and came anyway, with a staff, a chained grimoire and three good spells.

heroes.name: The Necromancer
heroes.lore: The castle's own trade, turned against it. Every corpse on the floor is a servant waiting for its word.

heroes.name: The Druid
heroes.lore: Antlers, feathers and a staff that still grows. The wild has its own quarrel with the Crimson Moon.
